t.zh: 子句里只有「对所有」，没有「存在」。已知里的 ∃ 外面没有 ∀ 时，可以像<part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>那样取出那一样东西；在 ∀ 底下就不行：「每个人都有父母」，父母随人而变。新元件「Skolem 化」把这样的 ∃ 换成一个<wiki-ref to="skolem"></wiki-ref>，比如 sk1(x)：x 的父母。它只认否定范式里的 ∃。
t.en: Clauses have only “for all”, no “there is”. An ∃ in a hypothesis with no ∀ outside it can be taken out as <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref> does; one under a ∀ cannot: “everyone has a parent”, and the parent depends on the person. The new card “Skolemise” replaces such an ∃ with a <wiki-ref to="skolem"></wiki-ref>, say sk1(x), the parent of x. It takes only an ∃ in negation normal form.

after.zh: Skolem 化前后的已知并不等价，只是同时可满足、同时不可满足，称为等可满足。
after.en: Skolemising does not keep the hypotheses equivalent, only satisfiable together or not at all: they are equisatisfiable.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，把每个目标的已知化成合取范式，再去掉 ∃。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that brings each goal’s hypotheses to conjunctive normal form, then takes the ∃s out.

hint.zh: ¬∀ 先要化成 ∃¬，∃ 才露出来。
hint.en: ¬∀ must become ∃¬ first, before the ∃ shows.

hint.zh: 第二个目标里，∃y 在 ∀x 底下：y 跟着 x 变。
hint.en: In the second goal ∃y is under ∀x: y depends on x.
